rationale.edition: All 39 changed paths live under web/src/** plus scripts/translations/.translation_state.json; none are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or any enterprise-owned module, and no enterprise keywords (SAML/SSO/SDR/cipher/etc.) appear. This is an open-source frontend change, so edition is oss.
rationale.skip: No opt-out marker is present: trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty and no tests-added label was passed. The diff touches user-facing Vue components and composables (alert dialog, dashboard panels, chart renderer), so it is not docs-only or CI-only and does not get skipped.
rationale.e2e: The change reworks a real UI flow: right-clicking a series on a dashboard chart and creating an alert from it. It adds a multi-query picker, a colorized query preview with a copy button in the confirm dialog, and injects SQL thresholds as HAVING clauses. These are user-exercisable interactions in web/src/** and warrant an E2E spec.
rationale.area: The functional core lives in web/src/components/alerts/, web/src/composables/, and web/src/utils/alerts/ (prefill from panel, alert source registry, confirm dialog), and the outcome is alert creation. The existing Alerts E2E folder (alerts-*.spec.js) is the closest home even though the entry point is a dashboard panel.
rationale.group: The Alerts shard group already runs alerts-e2e-flow, alerts-ui-operations, alerts-advanced, and siblings, so an alerts-from-panel spec belongs there rather than creating a new shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit tests under web/src/** (*.spec.ts) and Rust/none backend tests, none of which are Playwright E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/.
